title: Krispy Norwegian Lamb Roast
description: A traditional Norwegian dish featuring a crispy lamb leg roast, this recipe is perfect for a midnight craving. The yeasty flavor of the papillote adds a unique twist to the dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
In a small bowl, mix together the yeast, flour, and a pinch of salt.
Rub the lamb leg with the yeast mixture, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the lamb leg in a large piece of aluminum foil, leaving enough room to fold the foil over the lamb.
Dot the top of the lamb with butter and sprinkle with salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder.
Fold the foil over the lamb, creating a tight seal.
Place the lamb in a roasting pan and roast for 20 minutes per kilogram, or until the internal temperature reaches 70 degrees Celsius.
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Serve the lamb hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
